_sources.penalty_rule: NBA Rule 12B Sec. V: 4 team fouls per period without penalty (5th = 2 FTs); if a team has fewer than 4 team fouls at the 2:00 mark it is permitted ONE team foul in the last 2:00 without penalty. SAS had 1 at 2:00 -> Fox's foul was that one free foul; the next SAS foul would have been 2 FTs.
